useCase: Analyzing frequency energy 분포 이상 in AI 생성 images
mechanism: Decomposes the image into low, mid, and high frequency sub-bands using Butterworth bandpass filters. Computes energy 분포 에 걸친 bands and compares ratios. AI generators typically produce images with anomalous energy concentration in specific frequency bands due to their architecture limitations.
name: 주파수 대역 분석
source: Frank et al. (2020) - Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition, ICML
parameters: Filter type: Butterworth order 4, Bands: low (0-0.1π), mid (0.1π-0.4π), high (0.4π-π), Metrics: band energy ratio, spectral centroid
description: Decomposes image into multiple frequency sub-bands using filter banks. AI 생성 images show anomalous energy 분포 에 걸친 bands due to upsampling 아티팩트.

references.title: Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.
Durall, R. et al. (2020). Watch Your Up-Convolution: CNN Based Generative Deep Neural Networks Are Failing to Reproduce Spectral Distributions. CVPR.

strengths:
• Captures frequency-domain signatures of different AI models
• Complements 공간 영역 분석
• Adjustable band parameters for different generators
• Relatively robust to 공간 영역 조작s
limitations:
• Requires careful band parameter tuning
• JPEG 압축 affects high-frequency 분석
• Less distinctive for high-quality diffusion outputs
• Performance varies with image content type
